body.objective: Students will be able to use time words.
successCriteria: I can use time words and clock times in Mandarin
I can describe my daily routine with correct word order
I can sequence events with 先…然后…最后
body.hook: In Mandarin, time words come early in the sentence, before the verb, unlike in English, where we often say "I wake up at seven." Once you learn this word order, describing your whole day becomes simple.

study.title: 我的一天
study.question: How do I describe my daily routine in Mandarin?
study.passage:
Word order: Subject + time + (place) + verb.
• 我七点起床。Wǒ qī diǎn qǐchuáng. = I get up at seven.
• 我每天早上七点半吃早饭。Wǒ měitiān zǎoshang qī diǎn bàn chī zǎofàn. = Every day I eat breakfast at 7:30 in the morning.
Clock times: 八点 bā diǎn (8:00), 八点半 bā diǎn bàn (8:30), 八点一刻 bā diǎn yí kè (8:15), 八点十分 bā diǎn shí fēn (8:10).
Sequence: 先 xiān… (first), 然后 ránhòu… (then), 最后 zuìhòu… (finally).
Dialogue:
王明 Wáng Míng：你每天几点起床？Nǐ měitiān jǐ diǎn qǐchuáng?
莉莉 Lìlì：我早上六点半起床。我先洗澡，然后吃早饭，最后坐公共汽车去学校。
Wǒ zǎoshang liù diǎn bàn qǐchuáng. Wǒ xiān xǐzǎo, ránhòu chī zǎofàn, zuìhòu zuò gōnggòng qìchē qù xuéxiào.
王明：你几点上课？Nǐ jǐ diǎn shàngkè?
莉莉：八点四十五分。下午三点半下课。你呢？
Bā diǎn sìshíwǔ fēn. Xiàwǔ sān diǎn bàn xiàkè. Nǐ ne?
王明：我七点起床，晚上十一点睡觉。
Wǒ qī diǎn qǐchuáng, wǎnshang shíyī diǎn shuìjiào.
English support: 几点 jǐ diǎn = what time; 洗澡 xǐzǎo = shower/bathe; 吃早饭 chī zǎofàn = eat breakfast; 坐公共汽车 zuò gōnggòng qìchē = take the bus; 上课 shàngkè = start class; 下课 xiàkè = finish class.
Activity: Interview a partner about their daily schedule and draw a timeline of their day labelled in characters and pinyin.
study.source: Original dialogue written for this lesson.
steps: Learn time words and clock times
Practise subject + time + verb word order
Read the dialogue with a partner
Sequence actions with 先…然后…最后
Interview a partner and draw their timeline
discussion: What time does Lìlì get up, and what does she do first?
Where does the time word go in a Mandarin sentence?
How do you say 8:15 in two ways?
How is Wáng Míng's schedule different from Lìlì's?
study.product: Write a paragraph (8 sentences) in characters and pinyin describing your weekday routine, with at least five clock times, the correct word order and the sequence words 先, 然后 and 最后.

examples.title: Word order
examples.problem: Say "I go to sleep at 10 p.m."
examples.answer: 我晚上十点睡觉。Wǒ wǎnshang shí diǎn shuìjiào.

examples.title: Sequence
examples.problem: Say "First I eat breakfast, then I go to school."
examples.answer: 我先吃早饭，然后去学校。

examples.title: Asking time
examples.problem: Ask "What time do you finish class?"
examples.answer: 你几点下课？Nǐ jǐ diǎn xiàkè?

practice.a: 八点一刻 bā diǎn yí kè.

Where do time words go in Mandarin sentences?
practice.a: Before the verb, after or before the subject.

misconceptions: Putting time words at the end of the sentence
Forgetting tones on 点 and 半
Using 二 instead of 两 for 2:00 (两点)
exitTicket: Say three times of day in Mandarin.
Describe your morning in two sentences with correct word order.

items.answer: A) what time you finish class

items.q: Name four times of day in Mandarin.
items.answer: 早上, 中午, 下午, 晚上.

items.q: Explain Mandarin word order for time.

items.answer: She gets up at 6:30, showers, eats breakfast, then takes the bus to school.

items.q: Ask a partner what time they get up.
Write a sentence with 先…然后…最后.
Write a paragraph about your weekday routine.
Explain why 两点 is used instead of 二点.
items.answer: 两 is used for "two" before measure words like 点.
